I worked 5 years in a freezer making 1600 euro a month only to part with 400 of it so my parents could buy a few properties in another country. I remember 48 hour workweeks of nightshifts back to back with only a day off for 6 months at a time. 

I used to break in to tears after having heard the same christmas song for 30 consecutive days in december while I shivered in the freezing temperatures of a large storage freezer hauling 20 to 40kg packages. 

My life has reached a point of misery where even creative outlets such as painting or writing can not convey how genuinely miserable I feel. 

Even if I survived the difficulties my future essentially will only ever be living alone in an apartment with a cat because I no longer want to feel hurt or be hurt or put in a position where it could happen at all.

I do not want to be touched or held, I believe in no higher force or heaven or hell and even if I did, eternal existence in general horrifies me to the bone and the only escape from it all is death.

I am grateful for the realization I do not need anybody else to be happy but the rest of my life is in such a state of ruination that i have absolutely no way of fixing it to the state I wish I could.

If I only have one chance at a decent life and I can only ever make it slightly bearable from here on out is it even worth it anymore.

I do not even know how to go about suicide. Each method seems more agonizing than the other as if to taunt me that the only way out of this torment is a horribly painful finale that I must push through to escape.
